purpose: Compare isolated host-data kernels; no end-to-end application speedup claim.
methodology: Both final experiments pinned to CPU 0 and run sequentially; no concurrent review build or benchmark.
Copy: exact extracted writer methods, inline(never), runtime-visible 4096-frame capacity; seven rounds with variant order alternated.
Copy: asserts chronological window equivalence for 1/2/8/64 channels, wraps, exact capacity and oversized aligned blocks.
Publication: current release RunUi, seven rounds of 500 updates per case after 100 warmup calls; cases in fixed order.
Publication: includes input Value clone and message application; excludes native host projection, JSON parsing, scene layout, rendering and presentation.
Results are medians of seven per-round averages, not per-call latency percentiles.
No CPU governor/turbo isolation; values are local diagnostic evidence.
